title: HYG Database v4.1: 400 brightest catalog records
selection: Exclude HYG id 0 (the Sun), sort finite source records by ascending apparent visual magnitude then ascending HYG id, take the first 400.
changes: Select 400 records from the upstream v4.1 CSV.
Rename selected fields to the documented JSON keys and parse numeric text as JSON numbers.
Preserve the original numeric coordinate/magnitude/proper-motion values, proper/common names, and original identifiers; represent missing fields as null.
No synthetic stars, invented proper names, random positions, positional precession or epoch propagation are stored in this file.

fieldDefinitions.hygId: Original HYG v4.1 database primary key; stable provenance within this pinned version.
fieldDefinitions.hd: Original Henry Draper identifier, or null.
fieldDefinitions.hr: Original Harvard Revised / Yale Bright Star identifier, or null.
fieldDefinitions.name: Original HYG proper/common-name field, or null. Some companion labels in HYG v4.1 are explicitly unofficial; do not present every label as an IAU-approved proper name.
fieldDefinitions.raHours: Right ascension in decimal hours, epoch/equinox 2000.0; multiply by 15 for degrees.
fieldDefinitions.magnitude: Source apparent visual magnitude, not an absolute magnitude or current variable-star light curve.
fieldDefinitions.colorIndex: Source B minus V color index in magnitudes, or null; this is not a measured RGB color.
fieldDefinitions.bayer: Original upstream Bayer designation token, or null.
fieldDefinitions.constellation: Original upstream three-letter constellation abbreviation, or null.
fieldDefinitions.pmRaMasYr: Tangent-plane RA proper motion μ_α* = (dα/dt) cos δ, in milliarcseconds per Julian year. See properMotionEvidence for the evidence and caveat.
fieldDefinitions.pmDecMasYr: Declination proper motion dδ/dt in milliarcseconds per Julian year.

properMotionEvidence.definitionReference: ESA, The Hipparcos and Tycho Catalogues, Volume 1, section 2.1, H12/H13.
properMotionEvidence.upstreamReadmeCaveat: The HYG README states mas/year but does not explicitly spell out the RA cosine convention. The interpretation here is corroborated by original Hipparcos fields and by the source Cartesian velocities; it is not quoted as an explicit HYG README guarantee.
properMotionEvidence.crosscheckQuery: SELECT HIP, pmRA, pmDE FROM "I/239/hip_main" WHERE HIP IN (the 396 non-null HIP identifiers in bright-stars.json)
properMotionEvidence.internalVelocityCheck: For all 400 selected records, project upstream (vx,vy,vz) on (-sin(alpha),cos(alpha),0), divide by source distance, and convert radians/year to mas/year. This tangent-plane rate agrees with pmra to at most 0.31 mas/year at the published source precision. The comparison uses the unrounded source CSV vectors and does not alter distributed PM values.
properMotionEvidence.propagationScope: A UI may apply a documented linear tangent-vector proper-motion approximation from J2000 before precession/nutation. These catalog values alone do not give current astrometric measurements, a complete binary orbit, perspective acceleration or a topocentric/relativistic solution.

limitations: This is a brightness-limited educational subset, not a complete or precision astrometric catalog.
Close binary components are retained as separate upstream records and may overlap at wide-field display scales.
The magnitude and color values are catalog values; variable stars and unresolved multiple systems can differ from an observation on a particular night.
NASA image usage terms are separate; see /observatory/NASA-NOTICE.txt and /observatory/images.json.
